summaries.title: Stronger Models are NOT Stronger Teachers for Instruction Tuning
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Stronger Models are NOT Stronger** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Compatibility-Adjusted Reward (CAR) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this paper, we challenge this commonly-adopted assumption。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Recently, synthetic instruction datasets have emerged as an economically viable solution to provide LLMs diverse and high-quality instructions。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our extensive experiments across five base models and twenty response generators reveal that larger and stronger...；Our experiments across five base models demonstrate that CAR outperforms almost all baselines）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 38 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: JanusFlow: Harmonizing Autoregression and Rectified Flow for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our key finding demonstrates that rectified flow can be straightforwardly trained within the large language model framework, eliminating the need for...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（JanusFlow introduces a minimalist architecture that integrates autoregressive language models with rectified flow,...；Extensive experiments show that JanusFlow achieves comparable or superior performance to specialized models in...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 31 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: SAMPart3D: Segment Any Part in 3D Objects
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **SAMPart3D** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)）、智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：In this work, we introduce SAMPart3D, a scalable zero-shot 3D part segmentation framework that segments any 3D object into semantic parts at multiple granularities, without...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **Objaverse**。实验设计与验证细节：Compared to previous methods, our SAMPart3D can scale to the recent large-scale 3D object dataset Objaverse and handle complex, non-ordinary objects。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments show that our SAMPart3D significantly outperforms existing zero-shot 3D part segmentation methods, and can facilitate various applications such as part-level editing and...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 28 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: BLIP3-KALE: Knowledge Augmented Large-Scale Dense Captions

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用分阶段渐进式训练/建模流水线、高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We introduce BLIP3-KALE, a dataset of 218 million image-text pairs that bridges the gap between descriptive synthetic captions and factual web-scale alt-text。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We release the KALE dataset at）。

summaries.title: Scaling Properties of Diffusion Models for Perceptual Tasks
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Scaling Properties of Diffusion Models** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖测试时计算扩展（Test-Time Compute Scaling）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we argue that iterative computation with diffusion models offers a powerful paradigm for not only generation but also visual perception tasks。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Through a careful analysis of these scaling behaviors, we present various techniques to efficiently train diffusion models for visual perception tasks。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our models achieve improved or comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods using significantly less data and compute）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 13 赞），本工作为突破 **测试时计算扩展与高效思考 (TTC & Hybrid)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
